home.trust_note: You decide what you share, and how you appear.
home.note_top: You don't have to have it all figured out.
home.topics_title: There's room for your story here.
home.topics_lead: People write here about hard times, relationships, identity and recovery.
home.stories_lead: Every story belongs to the person who wrote it. Read gently, respect boundaries, and remember there's a person behind every word.
home.how_title: Sharing should feel safe and simple.
home.how_lead: No pressure to say everything. No need to show your face. You decide.
home.how1_text: Write, and add up to three photos if you like. You can check everything before sending.
home.how2_text: Anonymously, under a chosen name, or under your account name. We warn you if the text contains things like a phone number or email.
home.how3_text: Just to be heard, or advice. Keep replies open or turn them off. A moderator reads every story before it appears.
home.safety_title: Care is more than kind words.
home.safety_text: Privacy controls, content notes, reporting, moderator review and emergency numbers are built in from the start.
home.quote: You don't have to be okay to deserve kindness.
home.quote_note: Come as you are. Share only what feels safe.
category.stalking_desc: Someone following, watching or contacting you again and again, online or in person.
category.hate_incident_desc: Abuse, threats or discrimination because of caste, religion, race, ethnicity or identity.
story_topic.family_relationships_desc: What happens at home, in relationships, and the parts of life that are hard to explain.
story_topic.wellbeing_desc: Stress, loneliness, anxiety, grief, burnout, or simply a hard day.
story_topic.identity_belonging_desc: Who you are, what shaped you, and wanting to be accepted as yourself.
story_topic.harassment_recovery_desc: Share on your own terms, without blame or pressure to give details.
story_topic.support_connection_desc: Ask for advice, hear from people who've been there, or let someone know you're listening.
story_topic.hope_healing_desc: What helped, how far you've come. Those stories matter too.
story_display.anonymous_desc: No name is shown, and the story isn't linked to any account.
story_display.chosen_name_desc: A name you pick is shown. It doesn't have to be your real name.
story_display.account_name_desc: Everyone sees your account name, and the story is linked to your account.
story_support.listen: I just want someone to listen
story_support.similar: I'd like to hear similar experiences
story_replies.moderated_desc: People can write kind replies. Each one appears only after a moderator reads it.
story_replies.off_desc: No one can write a reply. Readers can still show they're there.
story_status.pending_help: No one has read it yet. Until a moderator approves it, no one else can see it.
story_status.rejected_help: It wasn't published, so no one can see it. You can delete it below.
story.f_display: How would you like to appear?
story.f_support: What would help most right now?
story.f_reviewed: I've checked this for details that could identify me or someone else.
story.error_body_length: Write at least 20 characters, and keep it under 10,000.
story.error_reply_length: Write at least two characters, and keep it under 2,000.
story.error_chosen_name: Enter your chosen name, or choose Anonymously.
story.error_account_name: Sign in to use your account name.
story.image_error_size: A photo is too large. Keep each one under 3 MB.
story.image_error_type: This file couldn't be opened as a photo. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
story.image_error_count: You can add up to three photos.
story.reaction_thanks: Thank you. The writer will know someone is there.
story.replies_off: Replies are turned off for this story.
story.reply_sent: Your reply has reached us. It appears after a moderator reads it.
story.report_sent: Thank you. Our moderators will look at it.
story.manage_not_found: No story matches that reference number and secret code. Check both and try again.
story.ws_reason_required: Give a reason of at least 5 characters when not publishing or taking down.
story.ws_help: Stories and replies sent by the public. Nothing appears until you approve it. Every decision is recorded.
story.ws_reason_hint: A reason is required when not publishing. The writer doesn't see it.
story.ws_identifiers_text: An automatic check found these. Look carefully before publishing:
story.ws_image_note: Hidden data has been removed, but check whether faces, names or places are visible.
story.ws_checklist: Before publishing, check for names, addresses, phone numbers or other identifying details; whether anyone is accused by name; whether a child could be identified; and whether publishing could put the writer at risk.
voices.none_title: No stories have been published yet
voices.none_text: The first one could be yours. A moderator reads each story before it appears.
voices.heading: People's stories
voices.lead: People write about their own lives here. A moderator reads every story before it appears.
voices.moderation_note: Stories are the writers' own experiences, not our views. If a story could harm someone, report it from the story page.
voices.react_title: Let the writer know you're there
voices.react_help: One tap is enough. No one sees who tapped.
voices.reply_form_help: Your reply appears only after a moderator reads it. Don't include anyone's phone number or address.
voices.reply_name_help: Leave empty to appear as Anonymous.
voices.replies_off_note: The writer has turned replies off. You can still use the buttons above to show you're there.
voices.report_help: Our moderators will look at it. The writer won't know who reported it.
voices.crisis_note: If you're in danger now, call 999. More help:
voices.new_heading: Your story. Your pace. Your choice.
voices.new_lead: You don't need perfect words. Start with what you're comfortable sharing.
voices.point1: Write anonymously, under a chosen name, or under your account name.
voices.point2: An anonymous story is never linked to an account. We don't ask for your name, phone or email.
voices.point3: A moderator reads every story before it appears.
voices.point4: We remove hidden data from photos, such as where they were taken. Faces or places in a photo can still identify someone.
voices.point5: If you change your mind, you can delete the story completely with your secret code.
voices.not_therapy: This is a place for people to support each other, not therapy or an emergency service. If you're in danger now, call 999.
voices.compose_hint: Only the fields marked with a star are needed.
voices.body_help: At least 20 characters. You don't have to explain everything.
voices.display_hint: Details in a story can identify people. You can change names, places, organisations or dates.
voices.chosen_name_help: Only needed for ‘Under a chosen name’. Don't use your real name.
voices.warning_help: Choose one if the story touches on something sensitive. Readers see the note before opening it.
voices.media_next_step: You can add photos on the next step.
voices.preview_heading: This is how your story will look
voices.preview_lead: Nothing has been sent yet. Check it, and change anything you need.
voices.warn_text: We found something like this. You can remove it with ‘Change something’ before sending:
voices.photos_help: Up to {n} photos, {mb} MB each and {total} MB in all (JPG, PNG or WebP). We remove hidden data from them, such as where they were taken.
voices.image_description_help: For people who can't see the photos, describe them in a line.
voices.av_not_yet: Audio and video can't be added yet. They'll be possible once we can store them safely and strip hidden data from them.
voices.submit_note: After you send it, a moderator reads it. Once published, anyone can read it. We can't say yet how soon.
voices.received_lead: It isn't public yet. It appears only after a moderator reads it; until then no one else can see it.
voices.received_keep_text: You'll need these to check on your story or delete it. We can't show the secret code again.
voices.received_next1: A moderator reads the story and checks for identifying details.
voices.received_next2: If all is well, it appears on the Stories page.
voices.received_next3: On the ‘Manage my story’ page you can check it or delete it any time with your reference number and secret code.
voices.manage_lead: Enter the reference number and secret code you got when you sent your story.
voices.manage_lost: If you lost the code we can't recover it. If the story is published, use ‘Report this story’ on its page to reach our moderators.
voices.manage_deleted: The story, its photos and its replies have been deleted.
voices.manage_delete_text: Deleting removes the story, its photos and replies for good. It can't be undone.
acc.title: Harm is taken seriously. People are protected.
acc.lead: Report cyberbullying, racist or hateful abuse, stalking and eve-teasing safely. Every report is checked carefully. This is not a place for public shaming.
acc.card1_text: Repeated harassment, threats, impersonation, unwanted contact, blackmail or coordinated abuse. You can report without having to face the person.
acc.card2_text: Slurs, targeted hate or discrimination because of caste, religion, race, ethnicity or identity. We look at the full context, not only a cropped screenshot.
acc.card3_text: Unwanted sexual comments or messages, street harassment, persistent unwanted attention. You decide what to share and whether to give your identity.
acc.flow_title: Accountability without putting the person who reports at risk.
acc.flow_text: Every report starts private. Our staff look at the evidence, protect personal details and try to be fair to everyone involved. Anything published comes only after consent, checks and removing identifying details.
acc.step1_text: Say what happened, when, and any evidence you can safely share.
acc.step2_text: Staff check the context, protect identifying details and look for immediate danger.
acc.step3_text: Where the evidence supports it, action fits how serious it is, with a route to appeal or correct it.
acc.callout: Remember: a report is an allegation, not proof of guilt. A decision by us is not a court verdict.
acc.also: You can also report threats, blackmail, corruption, child safety concerns or any other harm.
acc.stages_lead: We keep these four apart, so an allegation is never mistaken for proven fact.
acc.stage_a_text: What someone has told us. No one has checked it yet.
acc.stage_b_text: Staff are looking at the evidence and context. It does not mean anything has been proven.
acc.stage_c_text: We reached a decision or took action under our own rules, such as a referral. It is not a court verdict.
acc.stage_d_text: A court or official decision confirmed by reliable documents. Only then do we speak of a legal outcome.
acc.never1: Publish a list or ‘blacklist’ naming people.
acc.never2: Publish anyone's home address, phone number, private messages or intimate images.
acc.never3: Publish anything that identifies a child or a survivor.
acc.never4: Encourage attacks, revenge or pile-ons against anyone.
acc.fair_title: Fairness and the right to reply
acc.fair_text: People named in anything we publish can reply. You can ask for a correction and appeal our decisions. Our moderators flag and act on false, revenge or repeated campaign reports.
acc.published_text: We publish only after consent, safety, source, redaction and editorial checks. Each piece is labelled, so you can tell an allegation from a corroborated finding or a court outcome.
